extraction_policy.concepts: Only concepts explicitly present in the lecture titles, overview, or lecture text are cataloged.
extraction_policy.formulas: Core formulas are curated from the PDF and retain PDF page references; visually ambiguous symbols were checked against rendered pages.
extraction_policy.formula_design_profiles: Every canonical lecture formula is assigned to at least one reviewed experiment-design profile that separates primary and supporting formulas, supported variations, supported observations, and applicability conditions.
extraction_policy.experiment_design_patterns: A finite set of 15 reviewed experiment-design paradigms defines how formula-centered EMVR methods may be generated at runtime; every formula profile explicitly declares its applicable paradigms.
extraction_policy.scene_formula_links: Every internally numbered exploration scene is linked to one or more formula-design profiles through a separate many-to-many index; this index is not used by Guided-mode scene sampling.
extraction_policy.runtime_constraint: These notes define the ECE329 course boundary and the validated formula catalog. Brainstorming may also retrieve from supplemental_sources.json when an entry maps back to course-scope concept IDs. Uncataloged ECE329 claims require a reviewed source update.
